assessments.title: Actual target-f32 safeguards for selected numeric roles
assessments.classification: Independently corroborated existing safeguards; no new issue count
source_evidence: numeric.source:7–25 finite_in checks source f64 within inclusive caller bounds; :27–49 positive_f32_in converts first and rejects stored zero/nonfinite and source above the bound.
validation.source:515–520 uses stronger helper for shield block while armor values use finite_in; surface.source:120–129 applies it to coverage.

schema.source:72–85 exposes public EquipmentPhysical f32 dimensions, nonnegative-intended grip and signed anchor fields; validation.source:690–724 applies finite positive f64 dimensions, finite nonnegative f64 grip, and finite signed f64 anchors without a target-f32 check.
assessments.condition: Stronger helper is not a blanket guarantee over every physical field or public literal/deserializer. Zero grip and signed anchors are potentially intentional; the generic finite_in helper includes caller-supplied zero when allowed.

assessments.title: Dimension underflow and physical overflow remain conditional representation-boundary concerns
assessments.classification: Existing CAMERA-ADM03-F005 / 059 PL13-175 / REVIEW-CATALOG-PHYSICAL-DIMENSION-NARROWING-001 relationship, plus separately attributed /root/hair_ops finite grip/anchor overflow candidate; no alias or new count decided
source_evidence: validation.source:249–273 performs final typed ItemCatalogDocument preflight and discards the success value; build.source:253–262 validates parsed Value documents then :274–280 serializes original documents.

json-value.source:169–194,282–314 and json-number.source:535–546 under not arbitrary_precision pass f64 number to visitor; core-visitor.source:222–242,450–456 describes f64→f32 cast. A finite positive f64 can round to zero as f32 and a finite f64 outside f32 range can narrow to infinity.

loader.source:27–31 deserializes embedded JSON with expect. json-de.source:345–354,623–635,1508–1513 shows the inspected float_roundtrip f32 conversion branch rejects an infinite parse result; non-float_roundtrip number path 319–335,638–653 and visitor behavior is a different conditional branch.

projection.source:812–829 copies schema physical fields to tactical state, with instance overrides on y-length, grip, and y-offset. inventory.source:199–208 defines a positive/finite physical validity guard; drop.source:504–530 returns false if that check fails before collider creation.
assessments.conditions: A relevant scalar must reach the described feature-specific parser/visitor path with all other input and schema checks succeeding; build/runtime Cargo feature selection and host/target resolution are not established. Runtime parse failure and retained nonfinite value are alternative conditional paths, not observed outcomes. Real authored inputs, item selection, projections, other constructors/consumers and feature variants remain open; no parser, crafted input, build or runtime occurred. The tactical guard establishes the shown selected drop safeguard only, not that every consumer invokes it.
assessments.future_direction: After audit completion and authorization, decide a representation-aware admission boundary that preserves valid positive smallest f32 dimensions, signed offsets and permitted zero grip; trace retention and all consumers before selecting repair ownership.

assessments.title: Material string and typed enum relation
assessments.classification: Current bounded nonfinding; earlier rig CONTRACT-045 retained
source_evidence: material.source:1–17 accepts ten exact snake_case strings; schema.source:126–139 lists corresponding ten serde snake_case enum variants.

validation.source:662–680 requires a recognized material and a striking material for weapon kind, and disallows a supplied string striking material for non-weapons; final typed document decode at 269–273 is a separate schema safeguard.
assessments.condition: Matching lists show no current spelling mismatch in these inspected sources. Separate representations may drift in future, but that possibility alone is not an existing defect. Typed decoding and kind policies have separate roles; no full runtime material behavior inferred.

nonfindings: The selected tactical drop path invokes is_valid before collider creation, so an invalid physical value does not establish that this path creates an invalid collider.
A generic signed offset or nonnegative grip must not be forced strictly positive merely to repair dimension semantics.
Ten current material spellings match the typed enum; current render/material policy and all other callers were not assessed.
